note: Shasta-Trinity NF campground under open pines near the Upper McCloud River, about 400 m south of Hwy 89; tables, fire rings and some double sites. The Forest Service calls it suitable for larger RVs and trailers. The river is about 200 m from the nearest sites; the Cattle Camp Swimming Hole nearby is day use only, and a river-side trail runs 15 miles along the McCloud. --Claude
